patterns.note: Content sections are presented in a single-column flow with generous vertical spacing, often featuring asymmetrical two-column layouts for specific content blocks like book details or author information.

A highly distinctive handwritten script font is used exclusively for the main title/logo, providing a strong brand identity, contrasted with a clean, modern sans-serif for all other headings and body text.

The site employs a stark, high-contrast black and white color scheme as its primary palette, with subtle grey tones for secondary text and a single muted blue accent color derived from the product imagery.

The initial large, centered handwritten title dramatically shrinks, repositions to the top-left, and gains an underline, transforming into a compact sticky header with additional navigation links appearing on the right as the user scrolls down.

Sections are clearly delineated by ample vertical white space and distinct content blocks, rather than relying on background color changes or explicit dividers, maintaining a minimalist and airy feel.

technique_notes: A full-screen hero section features a large, centered, handwritten title on a solid black background, creating an immediate visual impact.

A sticky header system uses CSS keyframes to animate the initial hero title: it shrinks, moves to the top-left, and gains an underline, while new navigation links (Shop, Info) fade in and appear on the top-right as the user scrolls past the hero section.
Content sections are revealed by the natural scroll, appearing from below the viewport without additional explicit fade-in or slide-in animations, maintaining a clean and direct presentation.

design_tokens.type_scale: A strong contrast exists between the oversized, handwritten hero title and the clean, legible sans-serif body text, with headings being moderately larger than body text.
design_tokens.spacing: very airy, particularly in the hero section and between major content blocks, creating a sense of calm and focus.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its dynamic, transforming hero title that shrinks and repositions into a sticky header upon scroll, paired with a stark black and white aesthetic and unique handwritten typography. This creates an elegant, art-book-like experience that feels highly curated and personal.
